title: The count on the wall
logline: Forty box numbers written in a column on the garage wall in pencil beside the door, the way a child's heights get marked — 21 at knee height, 40 at the top of his reach — and the pup's height marked once among them, low, in 2015. The register as a growth chart.

panels.composition: A garage wall beside the door with a column of pencilled numbers rising from knee height to the top of a man's reach, one small mark low among them with a dog's name space left blank.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage wall beside a door with a column of pencilled numbers rising from knee height to the top of a man's reach and one small separate mark low among them, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The register as a growth chart.
